title: Your First Hunt
summary: Choose the creature whose Essence will begin your Soul Archive.

choice.selectionSummary: Study each creature's Essence abilities, then choose the one you want to claim.
choice.confirmationText: This choice determines the first guaranteed Essence in your Soul Archive.

options.title: Hunt the Goblin Warrior
options.summary: An aggressive bruiser that cleaves multiple enemies and empowers repeated attacks.

options.title: Hunt the Hollow Stag
options.summary: A magical fighter that weakens its target and grows tougher as it takes damage.

options.title: Hunt the Skeleton
options.summary: A sturdy physical fighter that opens combat with additional protection.

objectives.description: Defeat your chosen creature in the Training Area.
